validation_rules.name: Reference format
validation_rules.rule: Every reference matches ^PEL-(HSEQ|IT|FAC|PPL|PROC|FLT|CTR|SVC|TECH|DP|FIN|COM)-[1-5][0-9]{3}$

validation_rules.name: Band equals level
validation_rules.rule: The first digit of the sequence equals the cascade level
validation_rules.enforced: On create and on level change

validation_rules.name: Function matches
validation_rules.rule: The function code in the reference equals the function field

validation_rules.name: Reference immutable
validation_rules.rule: A reference is never edited once issued

validation_rules.name: Level change is a reissue
validation_rules.rule: Changing level withdraws the old reference and issues a new one with a Supersedes link

validation_rules.name: No reuse
validation_rules.rule: A withdrawn or superseded reference is never reissued

validation_rules.name: Parent required
validation_rules.rule: Every document below L1 names a parent

validation_rules.name: Policies must be implemented
validation_rules.rule: Every document of type Policy at L2 has at least one child at L3 or below. Statements and strategies are exempt: a statement declares, a strategy is implemented through the objectives register, and neither states a requirement that needs a method

validation_rules.name: Records must be required
validation_rules.rule: Every L5 names the document that requires it

validation_rules.name: Amendment record required
validation_rules.rule: No document is issued without a completed amendment record

validation_rules.name: Amendment reconciles
validation_rules.rule: The top amendment row matches version, date and author in the control block

validation_rules.name: Amendment rows immutable
validation_rules.rule: A previously issued amendment row is never edited or deleted

validation_rules.name: Published rendition is current
validation_rules.rule: A published rendition must render the current approved version

validation_rules.name: Only approved versions publish
validation_rules.rule: A published rendition is only produced from an approved version

validation_rules.name: Level in the footer
validation_rules.rule: The rendering pipeline stamps the cascade level into the footer of every page; it does not trust the author to

validation_rules.name: Ownership is role plus person
validation_rules.rule: Every document carries an owner role and the named person currently filling it. The role gives continuity, the person gives accountability

validation_rules.name: Distributions are not documents
validation_rules.rule: A copy sent anywhere is recorded as a distribution, never given a reference

validation_rules.name: Supersede same day
validation_rules.rule: On reissue the previous issue is superseded, archived and removed from the live library the same day

validation_rules.name: Retention is computable
validation_rules.rule: Retention is a number of years with a basis; a disposal date must be calculable

validation_rules.name: Review date required
validation_rules.rule: Every document states its review cycle and the basis for it. There is no default cycle; a cycle is justified by risk, statute or certification expectation

validation_rules.name: Spread the review load
validation_rules.rule: No more than 10 documents share a review date

validation_rules.name: Whole number versions
validation_rules.rule: Approved issues are whole numbers; decimals are drafts

validation_rules.name: Approver is not the author
validation_rules.rule: The approver of a version must not be the author of that version

validation_rules.name: External documents identified
validation_rules.rule: A document of external origin (HSE, a client, a supplier, a consultant) carries external_origin=true, its publisher, and is excluded from internal authorship rules. ISO 9001 7.5.3.2 requires documents of external origin to be identified and controlled

validation_rules.name: Review overdue alerting
validation_rules.rule: Any Issued document past its review date is alerted to the owner at 30 days before, on the day, and weekly after; the register reports the overdue count monthly

validation_rules.name: Access level required
validation_rules.rule: Every document carries an access level, defaulted from its taxonomy category, overridable per document with a reason

validation_rules.name: Cascade re-validated on withdrawal
validation_rules.rule: Withdrawing a document re-runs the orphan check on every document that named it as parent; new orphans are alerted the same day

validation_rules.name: Disposal is a logged event
validation_rules.rule: When retention expires, disposal (or the decision to retain longer, with a reason) is recorded in the events table. ISO 9001 7.5.3.2 d covers disposition, not just retention

validation_rules.name: Allocation is frozen and append-only
validation_rules.rule: The reference allocation is frozen at v4.0. A new document takes the next free number in its band; nothing is ever renumbered

validation_rules.name: Legacy references resolve
validation_rules.rule: Every legacy reference (IMS, PLA, PXL, MSF, MAN, PP, 000x) resolves through the register to exactly one live PEL reference

validation_rules.name: Event triggered review
validation_rules.rule: A legislative change detected by the application, an incident, an audit finding, a process change or a client requirement change opens a review on every linked document immediately, regardless of its cycle
validation_rules.severity: Block (the review task cannot be dismissed, only completed)

validation_rules.name: Filename grammar
validation_rules.rule: Every filename matches: PEL reference, space, Title Case title (acronyms protected, "and" not "&", no version markers inside the title), space, v<whole number>, extension

workflow_transitions.guard: A complete draft exists with an amendment entry drafted
R10 and R11 pass; approver named and dated
Published rendition generated by the pipeline (R14, R15); register row updated; previous version superseded the same day (R18)

workflow_transitions.actor: System, on issue of the next version
workflow_transitions.guard: Automatic; archived and removed from the live library
Reason recorded; cascade re-validated (R27); reference retired (R06)
No version increment; correction logged in the amendment record against the current version
Abandoned before issue; no reference consumed if never allocated
WITHDRAWAL AND REISSUE: old reference Withdrawn, new reference issued with a Supersedes link (R05)
For a safety-critical defect: expedited approval, full amendment entry, board notified at the next meeting; the emergency route is logged as an event and reported at management review

review_triggers.mechanism: The application monitors the legislation links held against each document (767 of them) and the HSE and ICO feeds; a detected change opens a review on every linked document the same day

review_triggers.trigger: Incident, near miss or ill health case
review_triggers.mechanism: Any incident reopens the assessments and procedures for the activity involved
New equipment, new site, new service line, restructure
A framework or utility client changes its standards
A revised HSE guidance note, British Standard or industry code
